title: Zechariah Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Zechariah 10: rain from Yahweh, the people without a shepherd, and the promise to strengthen Judah and save Joseph.

questions.text: What does the chapter say to ask of Yahweh in the spring time?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 10:1 says to ask Yahweh for rain in the spring time, because he makes storm clouds and gives rain showers for the plants in the field.

questions.text: Why do the people go their way like sheep and suffer oppression?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 10:2 says they are oppressed because there is no shepherd.

answers.text: Because the city walls have fallen

questions.text: What will Yahweh make the house of Judah like in the battle?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.

questions.text: According to verse 4, which things will come from him?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 10:4 says that from him will come the cornerstone, the nail, the battle bow and every ruler together.

answers.text: The harvest, the vineyard and the olive press
Silver, gold and bronze from the nations
Priests, prophets and judges for the people
The cornerstone, the nail and the battle bow

questions.text: Why will they fight as mighty men, treading down muddy streets?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 10:5 says they will fight because Yahweh is with them, and the riders on horses will be confounded.

answers.text: Because the king has paid them

questions.text: Which house does Yahweh promise to save in verse 6?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will save the house of Joseph and bring them back, because he has mercy on them.
Zechariah 10:7 says Ephraim will be like a mighty man and their heart will rejoice as through wine.

answers.text: Like a bridegroom at his wedding

questions.text: What will the people do when Yahweh sows them among the peoples?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 10:9 says that when he sows them among the peoples, they will remember him in far countries.

answers.text: Forget the land of their fathers
Choose a new king for themselves

questions.text: Out of which two lands does Yahweh say he will bring and gather his people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will bring them again out of the land of Egypt and gather them out of Assyria.

questions.text: What does verse 11 say will happen to the scepter of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Zechariah 10:11 says the pride of Assyria will be brought down and the scepter of Egypt will depart.

answers.text: It will be given to Judah
It will be carried to Jerusalem
It will be broken in two
